notes: Lecture Notes captures audio properly now: capture profiles (lecture hall / close mic / noisy room), a microphone picker with a live level meter and mic test, and crash-safe on-device saving — a crash or closed tab no longer loses your lecture, and it is never uploaded.

Whisper transcribes better: audio is level-checked and boosted first, silent audio is called out before any download, long lectures transcribe in parts, and a clearer Base model joins Tiny. Live captions show words as they’re heard and say so when they hiccup.
